Absolutely. The main choices are pretty simple:

• Classic watches: easy everyday styles focused on design, color, and simplicity.
• Swiss Made watches: a more premium option with sapphire glass and Swiss movement.
• Smartwatches: connected features like notifications, activity tracking, and on some models built-in GPS.
• Kids smartwatches: made for children, with child-focused connected features.
• Automatic watches: mechanical style watches that show off the movement and feel more traditional.

A strong place to start is this: if you want style first, go classic. If you want connected features, go smartwatch. If you want a more premium feel, go Swiss Made. If you want a statement piece, go automatic.
